item.title: Summer I and III Student Course Evaluations Now Open
item.description: Date: Friday, July 31, 2026 (all day) - Summer I and III student course evaluations are now open. The evaluation period is from 7/31 through 8/15. Your feedback is very important to the Institute, the five schools, and their departments, so please complete evaluation surveys for all your courses! Evaluations will be available through Saturday, August 15, 2026.
item.author: Students

item.title: Biotechnology and Interdisciplinary Studies Building Roof Replacement
item.description: The south-side roof of the Biotechnology and Interdisciplinary Studies Building is being replaced through the end of August 2026. A stair tower and overhead protective cover have been installed at the southeast entrance. Building entrances will remain open. Please use the designated sidewalks, use caution, and be mindful of overhead construction activities.
item.author: Community

item.title: Want to help support the Campus Cupboard?
item.description:
Date: Monday, August 10, 2026 9:00 AM - 10:00 AM - The Cupboard has partnered with the Bottle and can recycling company Clynk (found at most Hannaford stores). If you would like to donate send an email to offcampus@rpi.edu and we can provide you the bag and tag that you can fill and take to any donation center. The Cupboard will be credited with your donation. Also check out our website with other ways to support the Campus Cupboard

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
